measurement_history: Single measurement of independently authored blind set 2 (authored 2026-10-11 before any measurement; set committed c39c919 first). No tuning afterwards. Result: op top-1 74.29%, top-3 91.43%.

DEV RE-MEASUREMENT after search tuning (JA segmentation, thesaurus, coverage feature, fitted weights, generic phrases, abstain threshold); this set was inspected and is no longer blind. Fresh blind set 3 required. Result: op top-1 86.43%, top-3 97.14%.
interpretation: Measured once, untuned. Operation-level top-1 74.29%, top-3 91.43% on 140 intents (target 95% top-3: not met). Out-of-scope probes always return three candidates (search ranks; it has no confidence cutoff), so fail-closed behaviour is not demonstrated by search alone. Misses were not inspected for tuning; this set must not be used to tune the router. UPDATE: after the tuning round this set was read and used as development data (see measurement_history); the latest figures are NOT blind generalization estimates. A fresh blind set 3 authored by a different agent is required for the final claim.
